sequence_description: JWT IdP browser SSO: attempt kid-injection/key-confusion by using a JWT with a mismatched/attacker-chosen kid while keeping semantic claims valid; broker must reject if it verifies the exact proof under the intended key-selection policy.
description: [LLM-Judge] Kid-injection/key-confusion test did not demonstrate rejection: the 'attack' JWT login succeeded (HTTP 200), but the captured JWT header kid appears identical to the control kid, so the test may not have actually exercised mismatched-kid key selection (I1).

evidence.llm_judge_description: Kid-injection/key-confusion test did not demonstrate rejection: the 'attack' JWT login succeeded (HTTP 200), but the captured JWT header kid appears identical to the control kid, so the test may not have actually exercised mismatched-kid key selection (I1).

sequence_description: Direct token endpoint: attempt JWT bearer grant with an unsigned JWT (alg=none) while keeping semantic claims plausible; must be rejected to preserve proof integrity.
description: [LLM-Judge] Token endpoint JWT-bearer grant triggers HTTP 500 (server_error) for both valid-signed control and alg=none attack, indicating an internal error path instead of a clean OAuth error response; this is suspicious and may enable DoS or error-based probing.
